content.short: PoPP is a Web3 social proof-of-participation platform on Mantle enabling users to collect on-chain badges for real-world and digital experiences.
content.description: PoPP is a decentralized proof-of-participation protocol that issues NFT badges to users who attend events, complete activities, or participate in meaningful experiences  both in the real world and in digital environments. Each badge serves as a verifiable credential that contributes to the holder's on-chain identity and reputation. Organizations and event organizers use PoPP to reward attendance and create memorable digital mementos for their communities. The protocol is deployed on Mantle and integrates with the broader Mantle ecosystem.
content.meta: PoPP is a Web3 proof-of-participation platform issuing on-chain badges for events and experiences on Mantle. Discover PoPP on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
